title: Login times out after ~30s on slow connections
symptom: Users on slower networks see a spinner that never resolves and are eventually logged out with no error message.
resolution: The auth token refresh call had no timeout set, so it hung on the socket instead of failing fast. Added an 8s timeout with a retry, and a visible error state.

title: Payment fails silently for JPY and other zero-decimal currencies
symptom: Customers paying in JPY see 'processing' forever; the charge never completes and no error reaches the UI.
resolution: Amount was multiplied by 100 for every currency before sending to the processor, which is wrong for zero-decimal currencies like JPY. Added a currency-aware formatter and a regression test per currency type.

title: Exported CSV shows garbled characters for non-Latin names
symptom: Customer names with accents or non-Latin scripts appear as mojibake when opened in Excel on Windows.
resolution: Export was written without a BOM and defaulted to UTF-8; Excel on Windows needs a UTF-8 BOM to detect encoding correctly. Added the BOM to the export writer.

title: Customers receive the same notification email 2-3 times
symptom: Support tickets about duplicate 'your order shipped' emails, usually clustered right after a deploy.
resolution: The notification worker had no idempotency key, so a retry after a slow ack re-sent the same email. Added a dedupe key per (order_id, notification_type) with a 24h window.

title: Dashboard takes 10+ seconds to load for accounts with long history
symptom: Larger, older accounts report the dashboard hanging on load; smaller/newer accounts are fine.
resolution: The summary query scanned the full orders table with no date bound. Added a rolling 90-day materialized view the dashboard reads from instead.

title: Password reset email never arrives for some domains
symptom: Users on certain corporate email domains never get the reset link; no bounce is visible on our side.
resolution: Those domains' spam filters were rejecting mail from our sending IP due to a missing DMARC record. Fixed DNS records; not a code bug, but logged here because it looks identical to a delivery bug from the ticket alone.

title: Mobile app crashes when uploading a photo over 8MB
symptom: App crashes with no error dialog when attaching a large photo straight from camera.
resolution: Client-side resize ran on the main thread and the crash was an OOM, not a caught exception. Moved resizing to a background task with a hard cap before upload.

title: Webhook consumer processes the same event twice under load
symptom: Downstream systems occasionally see two records for one event during traffic spikes.
resolution: The webhook queue redelivers on slow acknowledgement, and processing wasn't idempotent. Added an event-id ledger checked before processing.
